answer: A mechanism that actually bites: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because timber only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, orchard is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any lantern approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
